subject.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls

question: Should this PR keep a new dedicated Android cron proof workflow, or should cron proof be folded into the existing Android validation surface before merge?
rationale: The diff adds a permanent feature-specific GitHub Actions workflow, and repository policy treats workflow/proof automation as merge-sensitive.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Android Validation
options.body: Move the cron proof into the existing Android CI or proof workflow pattern and avoid leaving a branch-specific workflow as a standalone lane.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Workflow
options.body: Accept the new workflow as a maintained Android cron proof lane with its current branch and manual-dispatch trigger shape.

options.title: Remove Workflow From This PR
